title: Prediction of risk of acquiring urinary tract infection during hospital stay based on machine-learning: A retrospective cohort study.
summary: Decision-tree and other ML models on regional hospital records estimate UTI risk, including hospital-acquired UTI, with large validation/test cohorts.
ai_technology: retrospective 301,932-admission cohort across four hospital trusts; training/validation plus independent month test. Decision tree provides entry-risk groups and models predict HA-UTI; retrospective prediction only.
